title: Level-Increase Charge: Days Covered and Care Fee Difference (Assisted Living)
content:
**Days covered.** Under the Assisted Living Residency and Care Agreement, the level-increase charge covers the days from the assessment date of the latest assessment through the last day of the billing month of the most recent full-month care fee charge, counting both days. The latest assessment is the most recent assessment of any type recorded on the residency, and the first day covered is its assessment date.

**Amount.** The level-increase charge bills the difference between the monthly care fee of the level the residency now carries and the full-month care fee charged for that month, divided by the days in that month, for each day covered, rounded once to the cent half up at the end.

### Worked figures (hypothetical)

The residency now carries Assisted Living Care Level 4, monthly care fee 2463.00. The full-month care fee charged for June, a 30-day month, is 1874.00 at Assisted Living Care Level 3. The latest assessment is dated 11 June.

| Quantity | Figure |
|---|---|
| Days covered, 11 June through 30 June, both counted | 20 |
| Monthly difference: 2463.00 less 1874.00 | 589.00 |
| Daily difference: 589.00 divided by 30 | 19.6333… |
| Charge: 19.6333… multiplied by 20, rounded once | 392.67 |

With the latest assessment dated 30 June the charge covers 1 day: 589.00 divided by 30, that is 19.63.
